body:
I'll start by assessing what's already downloaded, then fetch the missing source files needed for rigorous citation.

Now let me fetch the missing sources and inspect the tree in parallel.

downloads work. Let me fetch all relevant files in one batch.

Now let me systematically examine each target. Starting with UPGRADING sections and NEWS.

Let me read more UPGRADING sections (new classes URI, new functions, new methods, session changes) and the docs.

Now let me examine the URI extension stub (API surface) and implementation details.

Now let me look at parser differences and PHP.Watch docs for URI.

Now let me examine FILTER_THROW_ON_FAILURE implementation in detail.

Now let me check filter_var_array / filter_input_array specifics and the validation filters' error messages.

Key insight: `filter_var_array`/`filter_input_array` with a definition array silently set NULL for missing keys even with THROW_ON_FAILURE (line 645-648). Let me confirm via docs and check "sem chave" semantics.

Now let me look at max_memory_limit in main.c and related docs.

Now the PHP_BUILD constants and --ini=diff.

Registration may be in `main/php_constants.c` or `Zend/zend_builtin_functions.c` — let me download `main/php_constants.c` to find it.

Let me search via GitHub raw for the likely file `Zend/zend_builtin_functions.c` (already downloaded) or use GitHub code search through tree paths.

Registration likely in `main/php_ini.c` or via `zend_register_standard_constants`. Let me ask the tree for `php_constants` more broadly.

I'll accept the official UPGRADING/NEWS + PHP.Watch docs as citation for the constants, plus main.c for internals. Now let me examine deprecations in source: mhash, mysqli_execute, curl_close, socket_set_timeout, xml_parser_free, ob handler output, backticks.

I need additional files: ext/hash/hash.c, ext/mysqli/mysqli_api.c, ext/standard/var.c (ob handler?), Zend/zend_compile.c for backtick, ext/xml/xml.c, ext/sockets/sockets.c, ext/standard/streamsfuncs.c.

Now let me check mhash docs and mysqli docs, plus URI docs from PHP.Watch if available. Let me fetch the PHP.Watch 8.5 URI page if present (in docs listing there's no URI article). Let me check official announcement.

Need the session pipe warning code and the session_start ValueError code.

The pipe warning may be in `ext/session/session.c` with "contains a pipe" or in mod_files.c. Let me grep case-insensitively across session files.

Let me see the surrounding context in main.c to understand that list (removed INI entries).

Now let me examine the URI parsers deeply for RFC3986 vs WHATWG differences, normalization, validation and errors.

Let me look at property read mode selection in stub implementations (getHost, getScheme, getPath) — important for facts about decoded vs raw.

Need to verify RFC3986 host getter read mode behavior (percent-decoding?) and WhatWg getters. Let me read both host read implementations.

Need more observed differences RFC vs WHATWG: check uriparser parser rejects spaces; WHATWG parses relative vs RFC requires absolute; RFC3986 `parse()` returns null for invalid, constructor throws. Need parser `php_uri_parser_php_parse_url` for legacy parse_url pluggability (filter). Also check FILTER_VALIDATE_URL "uri_parser_class" option.

Let me check `php_uri_get_parser` default behavior (which parser when null) and read doc for official PHP 8.5 announcement URI.

I have enough source facts. Let me also verify URI-specific official announcement details from php.net and the RFC for RFC3986 vs WHATWG differences to strengthen facts.

Let me now gather a few final facts from NEWS/UPGRADING about `fatal_error_backtraces`, `register_argc_argv`, `report_memleaks`, `intl.error_level`, PDO `uri:` — for "configurações php.ini relevantes ao 8.5" and session sanitation. Then I'll write the report.

Before writing, let me verify the exact `-1` behavior of `memory_limit` with a finite `max_memory_limit` in the parser code.

Important nuance: `value` is `size_t` (unsigned), so `-1` parses as SIZE_MAX; `value != -1` comparison in C with size_t means -1 → SIZE_MAX, so the warning is suppressed but still clamped. Let me verify from main.c line 342: `if (value != -1)` — with `size_t value`, `-1` converts to SIZE_MAX, so this is true only when unlimited. Docs confirm warning wording "Failed to set memory_limit to unlimited... cannot be set to unlimited if max_memory_limit... is not unlimited". Let me check if there's a distinct warning in main.c or a patch version.

Now I'll produce the report. Let me verify a few remaining exact line numbers I plan to cite.

I have all facts verified. Writing the structured report now.

I spotted two typos in the report. Let me locate and fix them.

Report complete: 66 auditable facts covering all mandatory topics.

**Artefato:** `/tmp/php85-src/fatos-seguranca-config-85.md` (33,9 KB, 66 fatos).

**Cobertura obrigatória atendida:**

| Tópico | Fatos | Âncora primária |
|---|---|---|
| Extensão URI (RFC3986/WHATWG, parse/normalização/resolução, validação, getters, erros) | 1–24 | `ext/uri/php_uri.stub.php`, `php_uri.c`, `uri_parser_rfc3986.c`, `uri_parser_whatwg.c` |
| `FILTER_THROW_ON_FAILURE` + `Filter\FilterFailedException` (incompatibilidade, ValueError, mensagens, arrays sem chave) | 25–36 | `ext/filter/filter.c:242-306,549-608,624-745`, `filter_private.h:27,98-116` |
| `max_memory_limit` (INI_SYSTEM, -1, warning, `ini_set`, interação) | 37–41 | `main/main.c:330-390,889-890`, `php.ini-production:428-431` |
| `disable_classes` removido | 42 | `UPGRADING:52-54`, `main/main.c:2469` |
| `PHP_BUILD_PROVIDER`/`PHP_BUILD_DATE` | 45–46 | `main/main.c:105,117-124`, `configure.ac:1435-1438` |
| `php --ini=diff` | 43–44 | `sapi/cli/php_cli.c:512-513,835-844,1145-1171` |
| Deprecações (mhash, mysqli_execute, curl_close/share_close, socket_set_timeout, xml_parser_free, ob handler, backtick) | 53–59 | `UPGRADING`, arquivos `*_arginfo.h`, `zend_compile.c:10932`, `main/output.c:990` |
| Sessão e `php.ini` relevantes | 47–52, 61–66 | `ext/session/session.c`, `php.ini-production`, `NEWS:314-322` |

**Fontes adicionais baixadas via raw.githubusercontent.com** (commit `87bc4f73…`): `ext/uri/*` (10 arquivos), `ext/filter/*` (5), `main/{main.c,output.c}`, `php.ini-production/development`, `sapi/cli/php_cli.c`, `ext/{hash,mysqli,curl,sockets,xml,session}/*`, `Zend/zend_constants.c`.

**Notas de precisão incluídas no relatório:** `filter_var_array`/`filter_input_array` não lançam para chaves ausentes (fato 33); `FILTER_THROW_ON_FAILURE` tem precedência sobre `options['default']` em `filter_input()` (fato 32); `memory_limit=-1` também é clampado, sem warning numérico (fato 39); `curl_multi_close()` não foi deprecado (fato 55); `Url` não expõe `getHost()`, mas `getAsciiHost()`/`getUnicodeHost()` (fato 17).
